body.statement: A vector \(b\in\prod_{i\in V}[\nu^-_i,\nu^+_i]\) admits edge witnesses \(r_{jk}\in[\ell_{jk},u_{jk}]\) with \(b_j=r_{jk}b_k\) for all \((j,k)\in\vec E\) if and only if \(b\in\mathcal B_G\). In a connected component, either every coordinate is zero or every nonzero coordinate has one common sign; sign choices are independent across distinct components.
body.justification: This is the exact closure step discarded by separate bias-difference extrema.
body.gap: HuntingtonKlein2026 notes common signs and transitivity but does not state the componentwise if-and-only-if union, especially at zero.
body.consumer: It determines the correct feasible region and reduces sign enumeration from one bit per setting or edge to one bit per connected component.
